text: ok so i finally tried that new ramen place downtown and honestly? underwhelming. the broth was fine but they put WAY too much sodium in it and i was thirsty for like three hours after. my friend got the spicy version and said it was better. probably won't go back unless someone drags me there. the noodles were decent at least but nothing i couldn't get at the place on fifth. not worth the wait or the price honestly.
